This is strong pro-5B.7 evidence because it institutionalizes correction and review rather than slogan-driven rulemaking.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.6","5B.4"]},{"title":"Análises de Impacto Regulatório - AIR","publisher":"Banco Central do Brasil","date":"2024-09-26","url":"https://www.bcb.gov.br/estabilidadefinanceira/analise_impacto_regulatorio/solobasis_AIR","summary":"The central bank describes AIR as a systematic, evidence-based tool for evaluating regulatory alternatives before rules are issued. This supports the view that Lula’s policy environment in 2024 increasingly relied on technocratic, pre-decision analysis.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.6","5B.4"]},{"title":"Melhoria da qualidade regulatória: Anvisa publica estudos sobre Regulação Ágil e Regulação Experimental","publisher":"Anvisa","date":"2024-06-27","url":"https://www.gov.br/anvisa/pt-br/assuntos/noticias-anvisa/2024/melhoria-da-qualidade-regulatoria-anvisa-publica-estudos-sobre-regulacao-agil-e-regulacao-experimental","summary":"Anvisa published internal studies on agile and experimental regulation to help handle complex, fast-changing demands. This is good evidence that Lula-era governance favored learning, experimentation, and correction over rigid ideology.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.6"]},{"title":"Responsabilidade fiscal é compromisso do governo e será mantida à risca, diz Lula","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"2024-07-03","url":"https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/07/03/responsabilidade-fiscal-e-compromisso-do-governo-e-sera-mantida-a-risca-diz-lula.htm","summary":"Lula publicly pledged to keep fiscal responsibility “to the letter” and avoid economic shocks while still preserving transfers and growth. This is direct evidence of a rule-conscious posture rather than pure slogan politics.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.3","5B.4"]},{"title":"Brazil's central bank chief says monetary policy tied to fiscal fears","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-11-18","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-central-bank-chief-says-monetary-policy-tied-to-fiscal-fears-3728605","summary":"Campos Neto said fiscal concerns were influencing monetary conditions and that course corrections were needed. This is negative evidence that the policy environment still had credibility problems, even if Lula’s team claimed a disciplined approach.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.3"]},{"title":"Brasil’s government improves fiscal outlook for the year","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-09-20","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-government-improves-fiscal-outlook-for-the-year-3626553","summary":"The government cut its deficit forecast, but still needed a spending freeze to stay within the fiscal rule. This suggests corrective action, but also shows policy management was reactive and still under strain.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.3","5B.4"]},{"title":"Analysis-Brazil's tinkering to meet fiscal target threatens to dent credibility","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-09-18","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/analysisbrazils-tinkering-to-meet-fiscal-target-threatens-to-dent-credibility-3620814","summary":"Reuters said the government was becoming increasingly creative in its accounting for spending, tax exemptions, and fresh revenue, raising doubts about the credibility of the fiscal regime. This is one of the strongest counterexamples to evidence-based policymaking.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.3","5B.4"]},{"title":"Falas de Lula aumentam prêmio de risco e podem dificultar trabalho do BC, diz Campos Neto","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"2024-06-27","url":"https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/06/27/falas-de-lula-aumentam-premio-de-risco-e-podem-dificultar-trabalho-do-bc-diz-campos-neto.htm","summary":"Campos Neto said Lula’s speeches were worsening market pricing and making the central bank’s job harder. That is negative evidence for disciplined evidence-based communication, because rhetoric itself was moving markets.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.3"]},{"title":"Lula critica BC autônomo e diz que autoridade monetária não atende população","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"2024-07-01","url":"https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/07/01/lula-critica-bc-autonomo-e-diz-que-autoridade-monetaria-nao-atende-populacao.htm","summary":"Lula publicly pressed the central bank and argued it should look beyond what the financial system says. This is the clearest sign of slogan/political pressure overriding technocratic restraint.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.3","5B.4"]},{"title":"Lula to nominate Galípolo as cenbank chief","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-08-28","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-lula-to-nominate-galipolo-as-cenbank-chief-says-finance-minister-3591764","summary":"Lula selected a serving central-bank monetary policy director with finance-ministry experience, which is strong evidence for technocratic appointment rather than pure loyalty selection.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.2","5B.3"]},{"title":"Lula’s nominee to head Brazil central bank emphasizes freedom in decision-making","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-10-08","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/lulas-nominee-to-head-brazil-central-bank-emphasizes-freedom-in-decisionmaking-3653485","summary":"Galípolo told senators that Lula guaranteed him freedom in decision-making. That supports a reading of formal respect for expert autonomy.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.2","5B.3"]},{"title":"Brazilian ministers pledge measures to strengthen fiscal framework","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-10-30","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazilian-ministers-pledge-measures-to-strengthen-fiscal-framework-3691806","summary":"Haddad said cabinet negotiations were advancing on measures to strengthen the fiscal framework. This suggests the economic team was still operating as a genuine policy unit that could revise course.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.3","5B.2"]},{"title":"Brazil's government improves fiscal outlook for the year","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-09-20","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-government-improves-fiscal-outlook-for-the-year-3626553","summary":"Despite progress on the deficit forecast, the need for a spending freeze shows policy adjustment under pressure rather than denial.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.3"]},{"title":"Lula defende que Petrobras use dinheiro de dividendos para investimentos","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"2024-03-11","url":"https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/03/11/lula-defende-que-petrobras-use-dinheiro-de-dividendos-para-investimentos.htm","summary":"Lula said Petrobras should think beyond shareholders and divert more resources to investment. That may be defensible policy-wise, but it also shows political steering of a strategic firm rather than neutral, evidence-only decision-making.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.5","5B.4"]},{"title":"Fazenda insiste com Lula por aval a dividendo extra da Petrobras","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"2024-03-20","url":"https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/20/fazenda-insiste-com-lula-por-aval-a-dividendo-extra-da-petrobras.amp.htm","summary":"Reuters reported pressure on Lula to stop blocking Petrobras extraordinary dividends. This is evidence of a politically charged policy process that risked overriding market-based allocation.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.5","5B.4"]},{"title":"Ministério Público do TCU pede investigação de possível interferência do governo na Petrobras","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"2024-03-18","url":"https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/18/ministerio-publico-do-tcu-pede-investigacao-de-possivel-interferencia-do-governo-na-petrobras.htm","summary":"The TCU prosecutor sought an investigation into possible government interference in Petrobras, citing concerns that dividend decisions were being driven by government preference rather than economics. This is the sharpest institutional caveat against evidence-based policy.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.5","5B.4"]},{"title":"Lula is committed to fiscal responsibility, but market worries persist","publisher":"Reuters via Yahoo News","date":"2024-07-10","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/approval-brazils-lula-goes-july-115612793.html","summary":"The piece notes support for Lula’s central-bank criticism but also reflects market concern about fiscal targets and the real. It shows that Lula’s narrative resonated politically even as it raised policy credibility concerns.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.3","5B.4"]},{"title":"Lula’s government does not interfere with PF or judiciary","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"2024-01-30","url":"https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/01/30/lula-rebate-acusacoes-de-bolsonaro-sobre-operacao-da-pf.amp.htm","summary":"Lula denied interfering with police or courts and said PF actions were under court orders. This is positive on institutional restraint, but it is also self-defensive and not independently conclusive.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.5"]}]}
